guards.description: spec validate-invariants, spec validate-trace, and spec validate-action-coverage all silently report 0 file(s)/OK if this glob ever went to zero — exactly the class of bug D-124 exists to catch, applied to devai's own self-application surface.
packages/schemas/scripts/gen-types.mjs and copy-schemas.mjs both walk this directory; a silently-empty result would ship a package with no generated types and no bundled schemas.

devai docs cli regenerates this directory from the action catalog; a collapse here would mean the domain-page generator stopped discovering registered commands. The floor must move with `devai docs cli --write` output: R16's reorg produced one page per domain (16 incl. README) where 0.4 produced 36+ noun pages, and this guard sat red at HEAD undetected until the R17 audit (D-131) because the value was stale and the check was not in CI.
